observed.failure: First full 19-phase attempt reached K application startup, then render dispatcher marked the render FAILED with its stale-heartbeat interruption message.
observed.predecessorPhases: All I/J physical assertions passed in that attempt; the entire failed run is not counted as a pass.
observed.followup: A fresh isolated K-focused attempt uses added worker/queue/clock/log capture on failure. The successful path retains all media, queue, credit, isolation and restart assertions.
observed.cause: Not established by the first attempt. Do not claim a production worker fix or suppress lease checks. Track interrupted-worker and operational/load acceptance in RECOVERY-01L and NATIVE/SECURITY work.
observed.hostBuild: An optional standalone API compile initially found missing Prisma-generated types. npm run db:generate then npm run build:api passed; generated files are ignored, schema and migrations unchanged.

secondFailure.observed: Actual K media/render/API/credits/worker restarts passed, then the one-object historical verifier selected another key original as the later overwrite. Fixed selection by same key and distinct original version; verify all later objects. New 1-object and 3-object stateful S3-command regression workflows pass. No assertion removed.
